---
title: "How it fits together"
description: "What runs when: feature PRs, the release chain and the monthly sweeps."
---

The workflows cover three moments in a package's life. Each diagram shows
the trigger on the left and what ends up in your repository on the right.

## Pull request into `dev`

Every PR from a feature branch runs the checks and the bot suggestions in
parallel. Suggestions never land on your branch directly: each opens its own
small pull request *into* your feature branch, and a comment on your PR
links to it.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  pr(["PR: feature → dev"])
  pr --> check["R CMD check"]
  pr --> lint["Commitlint"]
  pr --> authors["DESCRIPTION authors"]
  pr --> rox["Roxygen suggestions"]
  pr --> tests["Test suggestions"]
  authors --> sub["Suggestion PR into the feature branch<br/>+ link comment on your PR"]
  rox --> sub
  tests --> sub
  tests -. "failing generated test" .-> fb["PR comment, or issue<br/>for a likely bug"]
  sub -- "merged or closed" --> clean["Bot branch deleted"]
```

Checks and suggestions only act if there is something to report; a PR
without changes to `R/` skips the suggestion workflows entirely.

## Release: `dev` into `main`

Opening a PR from `dev` into `main` is the only manual step. If the check
passes, the PR is merged automatically and the release is started as a
separate run.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  pr(["PR: dev → main"])
  pr --> head["Require head branch<br/>(only dev allowed)"]
  pr --> check["R CMD check"]
  check -- "success" --> merge["Merge PR"]
  check -- "failure" --> issue["Issue assigned<br/>to the PR author"]
  merge --> trigger["Trigger release<br/>(repository_dispatch)"]
  trigger --> release["semantic-release: next version,<br/>DESCRIPTION, tag, draft GitHub release"]
```

Why the release runs separately is explained on the
[release chain](release.qmd) page.

## Monthly sweep

On a schedule, the suggestion workflows review the *whole* package on
`dev`, not just changed files, and collect everything in one pull request
per month.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  cron(["Schedule, e.g. 1st of the month"])
  cron --> rox["Roxygen sweep of dev"]
  cron --> tests["Test sweep of dev"]
  rox --> pr["Sweep PR into dev"]
  tests --> pr
  tests -. "failing generated tests" .-> report["Report in the sweep PR,<br/>issues for likely bugs"]
  pr -- "merged or closed" --> clean["Bot branch deleted"]
```
